text:
Riley Adams: Need quick guidance - I submitted a 3-day client workshop expense and Concur flagged "per-diem mismatch." I used per-diem for meals but also charged two taxis on personal card and a handwritten taxi receipt with tip. Also one night minibar on corpcard shows as a lump "incidentals" amount with no itemization. What do we need to clear this?

ExpenseBot: Reminder: Per-diem cannot be combined with separate meal receipts for the same meal period. Handwritten receipts are accepted only for taxis under €25 if they show vendor name/date/amount. Hotel minibar must have itemized folio to be reimbursed; otherwise AP will classify as non-reimbursable unless manager approves. See https://redwood.internal/expenses/per-diem-guidelines :page_with_curl:

Riley Adams: Got it. For the taxis: one receipt is digital from Bolt with VAT line, other is a small paper receipt with driver signature and "€7.50" written and no VAT. For minibar, I only have the hotel folio PDF that lists "incidentals: €19.80" but no breakdown.

Maya Chen (Finance): Thanks. Actions: 1) Upload both taxi receipts to the Concur item and tag the paper taxi as "handwritten taxi receipt". 2) For per-diem, pick either per-diem for those meal days OR attach meal receipts and change expense type to "actuals." You cannot claim both. 3) For minibar, ask Front Desk for an itemized folio showing the minibar lines. If hotel cannot provide, manager must explicitly approve the incidental as reimbursable.

Javier Morales: Manager note: I approve the handwritten taxi €7.50 and the minibar €19.80 as business-related incidental for this client trip. Riley, please add this manager approval text to the Concur item so AP has an audit trail.

Riley Adams: Adding manager approval comment to Concur now and uploading the handwritten taxi photo. Also switching day 2 to "actuals" because I have meal receipts for that day.

ExpenseBot: AP action created: AP-TICKET-2026-145 (hotel itemization request). Reminder: if hotel provides itemized folio without VAT reg# we can still reimburse but cannot reclaim VAT.

Maya Chen (Finance): Once Concur is updated and manager approval is visible AP will process the reimbursement. Because you switched day 2 to actuals we will adjust per-diem pro-ration accordingly. Expect payout on next payroll cycle if all docs present.

Riley Adams: Thanks everyone. I'll follow up if hotel can't itemize. :thumbsup:
